title: Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups
summary: We prove that every word-hyperbolic one-relator group is virtually compact special. Combined with the work of Kielak–Linton, this resolves Wise's virtual free-by-cyclic conjecture for hyperbolic one-relator groups: every such group is virtually free-by-cyclic, with the free kernel allowed to have infinite rank.
family_title: Gersten’s conjecture and virtual compact specialness of one-relator groups

review.reason: Proves hyperbolic one-relator groups are virtually compact special, supporting Wise's conjecture.
